title: response_format set to verbose_json in provider/openai causes gpt-4o-transcribe being unusable
body:
### Description

In PR #8011, response_format is always set to verbose_json

causing the following error

`response_format 'verbose_json' is not compatible with model 'gpt-4o-transcribe'. Use 'json' or 'text' instead.`

### AI SDK Version

"@ai-sdk/openai": "^2.0.19",
"ai": "^5.0.21",

### Code of Conduct

- [x] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct

linked_prs.title: fix(provider/openai): do not set `response_format` to `verbose_json` if model is `gpt-4o-transcribe`

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue involves incompatible parameters passed to an LLM provider (OpenAI), specifically the response_format setting for the gpt-4o-transcribe model, which matches the "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" sub-category in the agent issue taxonomy.
